observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with a custom Darth Vader-themed skin.
Two silver DualShock 4 controllers are placed on top of the console.
The console has a glossy finish with a Darth Vader face design on the front.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 model, not a PS4 Pro or Slim.
The controllers look like standard DualShock 4s, not the newer DualShock 4 Pro.
The console is placed on a tiled surface, possibly indoors or in a garage.
There is a watermark 'SNYZ GADGET HOME' across the image.

claims.claim: USA used ps4 console and pad
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a PS4 console with two controllers, but no proof of origin (USA) or condition (used).
No screen or interface shown to verify installed games. Cannot be confirmed from photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI, power supply)
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting into the system menu, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may not function properly (e.g., buttons, analog sticks, power button)
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs (e.g., button presses, analog stick movement).

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated (not visible in photo)
risks.proof: Screenshot or video of the PS4 home screen showing the 5 games installed.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number (if not original)
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number on the back of the console and verification via official Sony website.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting into the system menu.
Video of both controllers connecting and functioning.
Screenshot or video of the 5 games installed on the console.
Photo of the serial number on the back of the console.
Proof of origin (e.g., receipt or proof of purchase from USA).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
